overview: The Medford City Council met to address various municipal concerns, including infrastructure funding, board appointments, and a major redevelopment project in Medford Square. The Council approved funding for recreation center repairs, referred a Winthrop Street plowing dispute and a zoning overlay amendment to committees, and rejected one historic commission appointment while approving others.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records of the February 24, 2026 meeting and the March 3, 2026 special joint meeting.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Report on Litigation Strategy
items.summary: Approved the March 4, 2026 Committee of the Whole report regarding litigation strategy and executive session.

items.title: Grant of Location, 57 Swan Street
items.summary: Placed on file a withdrawn National Grid petition for a grant of location at 57 Swan Street.

items.title: Winthrop Street Plowing Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution seeking plowing solutions for a steep private driveway serving residents on Winthrop Street to the Public Works and Facilities Committee.

items.title: Funding Medford's Tree Canopy
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging the administration to fund the implementation of the urban tree management plan and protect the city's tree canopy.

items.title: Board and Commission Appointments
items.summary: Voted to receive and place on file five appointments, while voting to reject the appointment of Sarah Berndt to the Historical Commission and suspending Rule 29 to allow for her resubmission with additional documentation.

items.title: Capital Stabilization Fund Appropriations
items.summary: Approved a $169,995 appropriation from the Capital Stabilization Fund for a new gym floor at the recreation center and a used Zamboni.

items.title: Medford Square Parcels Redevelopment Project Regulatory Vote
items.summary: Approved a regulatory vote declaring city-owned parcels surplus and authorizing a 99-year ground lease to Transom Real Estate, LLC, as amended to include an additional parcel.

items.title: Medford Square City Hall Overlay District Zoning Referral
items.summary: Referred proposed zoning ordinance amendments establishing a Medford Square City Hall Overlay District to the Community Development Board.
